title: Add a button and state
summary: React state remembers a value between renders.

learningObjectives: Start the count at 2 and press the button twice.
Explain the example for add a button and state

blocks.text: React state remembers a value between renders. A native Button calls onPress when activated.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

blocks.title: Add a button and state

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `onPress` is the native action callback. It is different from a web button's `onClick` prop.
`useState` gives React a remembered value and a setter. Call the setter to ask React to show the next value.

blocks.text: Each button press increases the visible number.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use onPress for this native Button. The web onClick property is not its action prop.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Start the count at 2 and press the button twice.
